name: [[780,64,10]] A5 monomial left-right product, weight5 checks

provenance.construction: G=A5, even permutations of(0,1,2,3,4) in lexicographic order, composition a*b sends i to a[b[i]]. Set row-action L_g[t,u]=1 iff u=g*t, R_h[t,u]=1 iff u=t*h. A=[[I,I,I],[I,L_16,L_26]], B=[[I,I,I],[I,R_17,R_25]]. X(i,j) has A(i,k) on VV(k,j) and B(l,j) on CC(i,l); Z(k,l) has transpose(B(l,j)) on VV(k,j) and transpose(A(i,k)) on CC(i,l). Keep the lexicographically first independent rows in each sector. Full matrices have360 rows per sector, ranks358 each.
